title: Prowlarr Cardigann indexer definition (v11)
description: Schema for Prowlarr Cardigann YAML indexer definitions, schema version 11. See the Cardigann YAML Definition page on the Servarr wiki for examples.

SchemaRoot.description: Root of an indexer definition: header, caps, settings, login, search and download blocks.

id.title: ID
id.description: Internal name of the indexer. Must be unique. Usually the site name in lower case without special characters or spaces.

replaces.title: Replaces
replaces.description: Old indexer IDs this definition replaces after a rename. Jackett field; Prowlarr does not read it.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of the site shown for the indexer.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code of the main language used on the site, usually from the site's <html lang> attribute.

type.title: Type
type.description: Indexer privacy. public: no registration required. semi-private: registration required but always open. private: invite or application needed. Magnet links are not generated from an infohash for private indexers.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Character encoding of the site, usually from its <meta charset> tag. Used for requests and URL encoding. Default: UTF-8.

followredirect.title: Follow redirect
followredirect.description: Follow HTTP redirects when loading the login form page (login method form). Default: false.

testlinktorrent.title: Test link torrent
testlinktorrent.description: When download selectors find a non-magnet link, fetch it first and skip to the next selector if the response is not a torrent file. Default: true.

requestDelay.title: Request delay
requestDelay.description: Minimum seconds between requests to the site. Only applies when greater than the default 2 second rate limit.

links.title: Links
links.description: Known site URLs. The first is the default and the user can pick any of them. Each must end with /.

legacylinks.title: Legacy links
legacylinks.description: Old site URLs that no longer work. A configured legacy URL is replaced with the first entry in links.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: SHA-1 fingerprints of untrusted HTTPS certificates to accept. Loaded by Prowlarr but not used.

caps.title: Capabilities
caps.description: Category mappings and supported search modes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Config fields shown for the indexer. If omitted, username and password are used. Set to [] when no settings are needed.

login.title: Login
login.description: Login configuration. Only needed if the site requires a login.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download handling. Only needed if the download link from the search results cannot be used directly.

SchemaRoot.title: SchemaRoot

Caps.description: Capabilities of the indexer: category mappings and supported search modes. Set either categories or categorymappings.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Simple map of tracker category ID to Newznab category name. Use either this or categorymappings.

^.*$.title: Newznab category
^.*$.description: Newznab category name for this tracker category ID. Unknown names are logged and skipped.

categorymappings.title: Category mappings
categorymappings.description: List of tracker categories with their Newznab category. Use either this or categories.

modes.title: Search modes
modes.description: Supported search modes and the parameters each one accepts.

allowrawsearch.title: Allow raw search
allowrawsearch.description: Advertise raw search support (searchEngine="raw") in the capabilities. Default: false.

allowtvsearchimdb.title: Allow TV search by IMDb
allowtvsearchimdb.description: Jackett field. Prowlarr does not read it; add imdbid to tv-search instead.

Caps.title: Caps

CategoryMapping.description: Maps one tracker category to a Newznab category.

id.title: ID
id.description: Tracker category ID, as used in search inputs (.Categories) and in the category result field.

cat.title: Newznab category
cat.description: Newznab category name this tracker category maps to. Unknown names are logged and the mapping is skipped.

desc.title: Description
desc.description: Tracker category name. Creates a matching custom category and is the value matched by the categorydesc result field (case-insensitive).

default.title: Default
default.description: Use this category when a search has no mapped categories. Default: false.

CategoryMapping.title: CategoryMapping

Modes.description: Supported search modes. search is required. Duplicate parameters or unknown modes are rejected by Prowlarr.
Modes.title: Modes

SettingsField.description: One config field shown for the indexer. Its value is available as .Config.<name>.

name.title: Name
name.description: Variable name. Referenced as .Config.<name>. The cookie login method reads the setting named cookie.

type.title: Type
type.description: text: text box. password: masked text box. checkbox: .Config.<name> is .True when ticked, else empty. select: drop-down of options; .Config.<name> is the selected key. info: info box showing label and default. info_category_8000, info_cookie, info_flaresolverr, info_useragent: predefined info boxes.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default value. text/password: initial value. checkbox: true or false (default false). select: key of the default option. info: text shown in the box.

options.title: Options
options.description: select only. Map of option key to display name. Options are listed sorted by key.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Default keys for a multi-select field. Prowlarr does not support multi-select and does not read this.

SettingsField.title: SettingsField

Login.description: How to log in to the site and how to detect a failed or expired login.

method.title: Method
method.description: form: load path, fill the HTML form and POST it. post: POST inputs to path. get: send inputs as a query string to path. cookie: use the cookie setting. oneurl: GET path with inputs.oneurl appended. Default: form.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Extra cookies (name=value) sent with the post login request and the form page request.

path.title: Path
path.description: Login URL, relative to the site link. form: page containing the form. post: POST target. get and oneurl: request URL. Supports templates.

submitpath.title: Submit path
submitpath.description: form only. POST target to use instead of the form's action attribute.

form.title: Form selector
form.description: form only. CSS selector of the login form. Default: form.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description: form only. Captcha shown to the user when adding the indexer. Adds a CAPTCHA field to the indexer settings.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Login parameters (name to template value). post/form: POST body. get: query string. oneurl: the oneurl key is appended to path. Not used by the cookie method.

selectors.title: Selectors
selectors.description: form only. Treat input names and captcha input as CSS selectors and use the matched element's name attribute. For forms with dynamic input names. Default: false.

selectorinputs.title: Selector inputs
selectorinputs.description: form only. POST parameters whose values are extracted from the login page with selectors, for example CSRF tokens.

getselectorinputs.title: GET selector inputs
getselectorinputs.description: form only. Parameters extracted from the login page with selectors and added to the submit URL query string instead of the POST body.

error.title: Error
error.description: Checks on the login response. If a selector matches, login fails with the matched text as the error.

test.title: Test
test.description: Login check. Prowlarr applies test.selector to HTML search responses; no match triggers a new login.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for login requests. If omitted, search.headers is used.

^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.title: Header values
^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.description: Header values. Prowlarr sends only the first value. Supports templates.

Login.title: Login

PageTestBlock.description: Check that the session is still logged in.

path.title: Path
path.description: Page to test the login on. Prowlarr does not read this.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: CSS selector that must match on HTML search responses. No match means the login expired and Prowlarr logs in again.

PageTestBlock.title: PageTestBlock

CaptchaBlock.description: Captcha on the login form. Requires login method form.

type.title: Type
type.description: Captcha type. Only image is implemented in Prowlarr; text fails with a not implemented error.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: CSS selector of the captcha element on the login page. Its src is downloaded and shown to the user.

input.title: Input
input.description: Name of the form field that receives the captcha text. A CSS selector if login.selectors is true.

CaptchaBlock.title: CaptchaBlock

ErrorBlock.description: Error check on the login response. A matching selector marks the login as failed.

path.title: Path
path.description: Page to check. Prowlarr does not read this.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: CSS selector. If it matches, the login failed and the matched element's text is the error message.

message.title: Message
message.description: Selector used to extract a better error message when the error selector matches.

ErrorBlock.title: ErrorBlock

SelectorBlock.description: Extracts one value from a result row or page. text overrides selector. Filters run on the result.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: HTML/XML: CSS selector, :root supported. JSON: path in the row object; a leading .. reads from the row instead of rows.attribute. Supports templates.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: HTML/XML only. Read this attribute instead of the element text.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Do not fail when the selector does not match. The field is left empty or set to default. Default: false.

default.title: Default
default.description: Value used when an optional selector returns nothing. Requires optional: true. Supports templates.

case.title: Case
case.description: Map of condition to value; the first match wins. HTML/XML: the key is a CSS selector matched against the element or its children. JSON: the key is compared to the value, * matches anything.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: HTML/XML only. CSS selector of child elements to remove before reading the value.

text.title: Text
text.description: Fixed value or template. Used instead of the selector.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filters applied to the value, in order.

allOf.title: Default requires optional
allOf.description: If default is set, optional must be true.

SelectorBlock.title: SelectorBlock

Search.description: Search requests and parsing of the results. Set either path or paths.

path.title: Path
path.description: Single search path. Converted to one paths entry with inheritinputs true.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Search paths. Each matching path is requested for every search; duplicate GET URLs are skipped.

allowEmptyInputs.title: Allow empty inputs
allowEmptyInputs.description: Send inputs whose value is empty. By default an input that resolves to an empty value is left out. Default: false.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Request parameters shared by all paths (name to template value). GET: query string. POST: form data. The $raw key is split on & and = and added without further escaping (only variables are escaped).

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for search requests. Also used for login and download requests that set no headers of their own.

^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.title: Header values
^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.description: Header values. Prowlarr sends only the first value. Supports templates.

keywordsfilters.title: Keywords filters
keywordsfilters.description: Filters applied to the search keywords. The result is available as .Keywords.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error checks on the search result page. Prowlarr does not read this.

preprocessingfilters.title: Preprocessing filters
preprocessingfilters.description: Filters applied to the whole HTML or XML response before parsing. Not applied to JSON responses.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: How to find the result rows.

Search.title: Search

path.title: Path
path.description: Search URL, relative to the site link. Supports templates; variables are URL encoded.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method. post (case-insensitive) sends inputs as form data. Anything else uses GET. Default: get.

followredirect.title: Follow redirect
followredirect.description: Follow HTTP redirects for this search request. Default: false.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Only use this path if the search includes one of these tracker category IDs. A ! as the first entry inverts the match. Without !, .Categories is limited to the matching IDs.

items.title: Tracker category
items.description: Tracker category ID, or ! as the first entry.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Extra request parameters for this path. Added after search.inputs when inheritinputs is true.

inheritinputs.title: Inherit inputs
inheritinputs.description: Include search.inputs in this path's request. Default: true.

queryseparator.title: Query separator
queryseparator.description: Separator between query parameters. Prowlarr ignores it for search paths and always uses &.

response.title: Response
response.description: Response format. If omitted the response is parsed as HTML.

type.title: Type
type.description: json or xml. Omit the response block for HTML.

noResultsMessage.title: No results message
noResultsMessage.description: JSON only. If the response contains this text, return no results instead of an error. An empty string matches an empty response.

RowsBlock.description: Selects the result rows. Each row is parsed with fields.

after.title: After
after.description: HTML/XML only. Merge this many following rows into each row, for sites that split one result over several rows. Default: 0.

dateheaders.title: Date headers
dateheaders.description: HTML/XML only. For results without a date, search previous sibling rows for a date with this selector.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: HTML/XML: CSS selector for the rows. JSON: path to the rows array; :has(), :not() and :contains() filters are supported. Supports templates.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: JSON only. Sub-object of each row that holds the fields. Fields with a .. prefix still read from the row.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Not used for rows by Prowlarr.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: JSON only. The attribute holds several results per row; each one becomes a release. Default: false.

missingAttributeEqualsNoResults.title: Missing attribute equals no results
missingAttributeEqualsNoResults.description: JSON only. Treat a missing rows selector or attribute as no results instead of an error. Default: false.

case.title: Case
case.description: Not used for rows by Prowlarr.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Not used for rows by Prowlarr.

text.title: Text
text.description: Not used for rows by Prowlarr.

filters.title: Row filters
filters.description: Filters applied to each row after its fields are parsed.

count.title: Count
count.description: JSON only. Selector for a result count. A count below 1 returns no results.

RowsBlock.title: RowsBlock

FieldsBlock.description: Fields extracted from each row, parsed in order. Each value is available as .Result.<name> to later fields. Required: title, size, seeders, one of category or categorydesc, and at least one of download, magnet or infohash.

^_[A-Za-z0-9-_]*$.title: Working field
^_[A-Za-z0-9-_]*$.description: Name starting with _. Not mapped to the release; use it through .Result.<name> in later fields.

^((title|description)\\|(append))?$.title: Title or description with append
^((title|description)\\|(append))?$.description: title|append or description|append adds the value to the end of the value set by an earlier field.

^((category|categorydesc)\\|(noappend|ap.title: Category with modifier
^((category|categorydesc)\\|(noappend|ap.description: category or categorydesc with a modifier. Categories from repeated fields are merged by default. noappend replaces instead and is deprecated.

^(download|magnet|infohash|details|comme.title: Release field
^(download|magnet|infohash|details|comme.description: Known release field. download: .torrent or magnet link. magnet: magnet link. infohash: generates a magnet link for non-private indexers. details/comments: page links. category: tracker category ID. categorydesc: tracker category name. size: size with units. date: publish date. seeders/leechers/files/grabs: counts. downloadvolumefactor: share of download counted, 0 is freeleech. uploadvolumefactor: share of upload counted, 2 is double upload. minimumratio, minimumseedtime (seconds). imdb/imdbid/tmdbid/rageid/tvdbid/tvmazeid/traktid/doubanid: first number is used. poster: image URL. genre: list split on punctuation and spaces. year, author, booktitle, publisher, album, artist, label, track. IDs, poster, description and genre are optional by default. A name with a _suffix is a working field.

oneOf.title: Using category
oneOf.description: Set category or categorydesc, not both.

oneOf.title: Using categorydesc
oneOf.description: Set category or categorydesc, not both.

anyOf.title: Has download
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

anyOf.title: Has infohash
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

anyOf.title: Has magnet
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

FieldsBlock.title: FieldsBlock

DownloadBlock.description: Download handling when the result link is not the file itself. infohash takes precedence over selectors.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method for the final download request. post uses POST, anything else GET. Default: get.

before.title: Before
before.description: Request sent before the download, for example to press a thanks button.

selectors.title: Selectors
selectors.description: Selector fields (selector, attribute, usebeforeresponse, filters) tried in order on the page behind the result link. The first that returns a usable link is downloaded; the rest are fallbacks.

infohash.title: Infohash
infohash.description: Build a magnet link from a hash and title found on the page behind the result link.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for download and before requests. If omitted, search.headers is used.

^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.title: Header values
^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$.description: Header values. Prowlarr sends only the first value. Supports templates.

DownloadBlock.title: DownloadBlock

BeforeBlock.description: Request sent before the download. Set either path or pathselector.

path.title: Path
path.description: URL of the request, relative to the site link. Supports templates, including .DownloadUri variables.

pathselector.title: Path selector
pathselector.description: Selector that reads the request URL from the page behind the result link.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method. post (case-insensitive) sends inputs as form data. Anything else uses GET. Default: get.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Request parameters (name to template value). GET: query string. POST: form data.

queryseparator.title: Query separator
queryseparator.description: Separator between GET query parameters. Default: &.

oneOf.title: Using pathselector
oneOf.description: before with a path read from the page.

BeforeBlock.title: BeforeBlock

InfoHashBlock.description: Builds a magnet link from a hash and a title. Meant for public and semi-private indexers.

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: Selector for the info hash (the magnet xt parameter).

title.title: Title
title.description: Selector for the release name (the magnet dn parameter).

usebeforeresponse.title: Use before response
usebeforeresponse.description: Read hash and title from the before response instead of the page behind the result link. Default: false.

InfoHashBlock.title: InfoHashBlock

SelectorField.description: Selector used by the download block.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the element text, for example href.

usebeforeresponse.title: Use before response
usebeforeresponse.description: Apply the selector to the before response instead of the page behind the result link. Default: false.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filters applied to the value, in order.

SelectorField.title: SelectorField

RowFilterBlock.description: Filter applied to each result row.

name.title: Name
name.description: andmatch: drop releases whose title or description match fewer than two search terms (one for single-term queries). Not applied to RSS or ID searches. strdump: log each row for debugging.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Prowlarr does not read arguments for row filters.

RowFilterBlock.title: RowFilterBlock

name.title: Name
name.description: querystring: value of a query parameter (args: name). timeparse/dateparse: parse a date (args: layout). regexp: first capture group (args: pattern). re_replace: args [pattern, replacement]. split: args [separator, index], negative index counts from the end. replace: args [from, to]. trim: trim whitespace or the args character. prepend/append: add args text. tolower/toupper. urldecode/urlencode. htmldecode/htmlencode. timeago/reltime: relative time. fuzzytime: date in any common format. validfilename. diacritics: args replace strips accents. jsonjoinarray: args [JSONPath, separator]. hexdump/strdump: log the value. validate: keep only the words listed in args.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Filter argument: a string, an integer, or a list, depending on the filter.

allOf.title: dateparse layout check
allOf.description: dateparse args must be a .NET style layout without digits, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

IndexerCategories.description: Newznab category name. Must match a Prowlarr standard category name exactly.
IndexerCategories.title: IndexerCategories
